title: Strategy map
description: Kaplan and Norton strategy maps whose cause-and-effect links are stated as assumptions the team can test.

sources.title: HBS Working Knowledge, Mapping Your Corporate Strategy: Robert S. Kaplan on Kaplan and Norton's Strategy Maps

rules.instruction: When using a strategy map, link changes in team capabilities or processes to expected customer and business outcomes. Mark causal links as hypotheses and state what would invalidate them.
rules.verification: Review one critical link in the proposed strategy with its owner. Identify the observation and review date that would change the decision about resourcing it.

rules.instruction: At the review date, compare the measure observed for each reviewed link with the expected effect. Ask the strategy owner whether to keep, revise or drop the link.
rules.verification: Check that the review record gives the observed measure and the owner's decision for each reviewed link.
